node.title: Re: Changing filename extensions
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Just to add to what the others have said about checking for errors: always [id://111088]. You may also be interested in [doc://autodie] as an alternative to checking every call for errors.

Personally, when batch renaming files, I tend to use Larry's [https://metacpan.org/dist/File-Rename/view/rename.PL|rename] script from [dist://File::Rename]. For recursive operations I would combine that with [man://find].
